newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB raises 1995/96 durum payment on some grades.
newsitem.headline: CWB raises 1995/96 durum payment on some grades.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board on Thursday said it would make an interim payment on some grades of durum wheat delivered in crop year 1995/96 (Aug/July).

Interim payments are made when there is enough of a difference between the government-guaranteed initial payment set at the start of the crop year and the total expected return once that crop year is over, the CWB statement said.
Final payments are often made in January following the July 31 year end.
Payments on No1 and No2 Canada Western Amber Durum with 12.5 percent protein were increased C$18 a tonne.
Payments on No1 and 2 CWAD with less than 12.5 percent protein, and on all No3 CWAD, will be C$12 a tonne, the CWB said.
